newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Feb crude output rose, natgas lower - EGPC.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Feb crude output rose, natgas lower - EGPC.

text.p: Egyptian crude oil production rose slightly in February to an average of 845,400 barrels per day (bpd) from 845,000 bpd in January, the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) said on Wednesday.
But EGPC said natural gas output fell marginally to 1.303 billion cubic feet a day from January's 1.33 billion cubic feet.
Condensates were higher at 36,100 bpd from 35,000 bpd in January and butane and propane output was also more at 32,500 compared to 32,000, EGPC said.
